sources.title: Tutoring Management System / Sistema de Monitoria
facts: Version 2.0 is complete. Its public demo is at https://tutoring.joaoabreu.dev.
The Java 21 and Spring Boot REST API and React client share one repository. The database is PostgreSQL.
The API authenticates users with JWTs, checks permissions for administrative actions and returns HTTP 409 for invalid state transitions.
When a confirmed student cancels, the next student on the waitlist gets the seat and the queue is updated in the same transaction.
The v2.0 backend suite contains 182 automated tests, including service and HTTP tests. It runs in GitHub Actions.
limitations: The test count describes the v2.0 backend suite. It is not a coverage percentage.

sources.title: Hallo Pflege
facts: Since November 2026, João has been the sole developer responsible for Hallo Pflege, a pre-launch platform for nursing materials. He reports directly to the CEO.
He built the site in Portuguese, German and English with Next.js and TypeScript and configured Payload CMS so the CEO can publish materials herself.
He developed a design system with WCAG AA as an accessibility target and configured continuous integration with GitHub Actions.

sources.title: Personal portfolio
facts: His bilingual portfolio uses Astro and TypeScript with a Spring Boot API in the same repository.
Visitors can ask the live AI assistant about his work. GitHub sign-in protects the admin area.
The portfolio runs on an Ubuntu VM on AWS Lightsail. nginx sits behind Cloudflare and routes API requests to two Spring Boot instances. GitHub Actions deploys the site.
CodeQL and Dependabot are configured in the monorepo.
